name: @finverify/extension
description: FinVerify browser extension — a thin client of @finverify/core. Owns DOM adapters, a chrome.runtime-messaging transport, and UI wiring; all claim detection, trust scoring, batching, dedup, retry, and cancellation logic lives in @finverify/core.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && rimraf dist && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.background.config.ts && vite build --config vite.popup.config.ts && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
